title: AI Safety, Alignment, and Ethics (AI SAE): Designing Symbiotic AI Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical evaluation of contemporary alignment methods (e.g., RLHF, Constitutional AI) for their coverage of the 'moral problem space', alongside proposed empirical methodologies such as using sparse autoencoders (SAEs), dictionary learning, and causal interventions to probe and measure invariant moral structures in latent spaces.

Proposed methodologies including clustering in representation space, contrastive learning with an 'evolutionary philosophical corpus', and testing out-of-distribution (OOD) preservation of local coherence to disentangle universal moral features from sociohistorical or cultural distortions.
